Iran Courts Order US to Pay $290 Billion in Damages

Iranian courts have ordered the United States to pay $290 billion in damages for alleged decades of US actions against the Islamic Republic, according to a judiciary official. Lawsuits have also been filed against Gulf Arab states accused of allowing Washington to use their territory to strike Iran.
